question: When does the spring semester start and when is the last day to drop a class?
answer: The regular Spring 2027 semester begins on January 11 2027. The last day to drop (student‑initiated withdrawal) a 16‑week Spring 2027 class is April 8 2027.

citations.label: Last day for student‑initiated withdrawal (Regular 16‑week session)

next_steps: Mark the start date (Jan 11 2027) and drop deadline (Apr 8 2027) on your calendar.
Check the CCC academic calendar online for any updates before the semester begins.
If you anticipate needing to drop a class, contact the Registrar’s Office early to confirm the withdrawal process.
